ICSIL Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ICSIL Data Entry Operator posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator posts is scheduled for 15th September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification for the Data Entry Operator position is Graduation. Candidates should possess a graduate degree to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Data Entry Operator is Rs. 937/- per day, as per the minimum wages notified by the Labour Department, GNCT of Delhi.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Data Entry Operator position in this recruitment drive by ICSIL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for ICSIL Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of Rs. 590/- for this recruitment process.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this ICSIL recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q7. What is the experience required for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: Candidates with 0 to 3 years of experience are eligible to apply for the Data Entry Operator position.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the ICSIL office in New Delhi. The exact address and timings will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age limit for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Please refer to the official notification for specific age limit details and any applicable age relaxations for the Data Entry Operator position.
